situation: A brief for a platform connecting five kinds of participant. No single screen shows the value.

expect.because: a five-sided flow cannot be shown on one screen, so a screenshot would have to be fabricated

situation: A directory of records. The user arrives knowing the name of what they want to find.

expect.because: the first physical step of the job is finding something, so a button adds a step the search box removes

situation: A brief for a product where no interface exists yet and no data has ever flowed through it.

expect.because: showing a product that does not exist is the failure the derivation exists to prevent

forbid_symptoms: It reads like every other AI product

situation: A tool whose entire value is visible on one populated screen.

expect.because: when one screen does show the value, it is the strongest available evidence and nothing beats it
